defects.description: Description: "bring ONE hand up near the face or jaw. Relax the OTHER arm at your side". Currently leftShoulder=-110 AND rightShoulder=-110 (BOTH arms overhead). OTHER arm should be at side relaxed.
L arm overhead + elbow 100° leaves wristL 0.638m from head. Description says hand "near the face or jaw" — needs deeper elbow bend.

regression_risk: low — R arm changes from overhead to side; L elbow deepens. Re-render verify recommended.
rationale: L arm (hand near face/jaw): PRESERVED leftShoulder=-110, shoulderFwdL=15. leftElbow 100 → 130 (deeper bend brings wristL closer to head, distance 0.638 → 0.520). R arm (relaxed at side): rightShoulder -110 → 0 (arm hangs down at side), rightElbow 15 → 0 (straight), shoulderFwdR 5 → 0 (no swing). With globalTilt=-85 (mostly supine), arm hangs down in body frame → extends sideways along floor in world (wristR at y=0.068, near floor). Legs PRESERVED: leftHip=8/leftKnee=10 (L extended), rightHip=90/rightKnee=88 (R bent up) — matches "Bend one leg up while keeping the other extended". globalTilt=-85 verified SUPINE (per cron-round-1 fix). Same pattern as p13-floor-s4: PR-v4 both-shoulder overshoot applied to a pose that needs asymmetric arms.
